description: Assign each VDM-SL module to the lightest capable model tier (light / standard / heavy) based on objective complexity signals in the contract itself — operation counts, implicit definitions, state invariants, quantifiers, and proof-obligation counts — to cut token cost without weakening the verification safety net. Produces MODEL-ROUTING.md (human-readable, with rationale) and model-routing.json (machine-readable, consumed by generate-code / generate-tests / integrated-workflow). Triggered by: "route models", "assign models per module", "reduce token cost", "which modules can use a lighter model".
